I replied in #coastal-team: the lamp delivery at door 6 was Pellow, not Pellucid.

The answer comes from the 17 Feb thread in that channel. Kwame said your retail account was the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6, not the container pickup, and you confirmed it. Pellow Home Living is your retail account, renamed from Covey & Lark Retail. The container pickup was Pellucid Harbor Logistics, the Gulf Coast terminal account.
